name: comexstat.dicionario.vias

constraints.string_storage_reason: Memory guard counts pooled Python string objects once
constraints.codes: Literal ASCII codes; leading zeros and special codes are preserved
constraints.urf: Unidade da Receita Federal; no physical port is inferred
constraints.missing_measures: Missing contributions propagate to the corresponding aggregate

guarantees: All published dictionary fields and row order are preserved
Names, whitespace, special codes and multiplicity remain literal
MDIC codes are not deduplicated by ISO code or description
The acquired dictionary does not establish historical validity or a snapshot
